verdict.rationale: Fly.io's platform is built around deploying VMs 'close to your users' across many regions (fly-io-docs-14) and flyctl/CLI tooling supports app deployment (fly-io-docs-1, fly-io-probe-4), which is the core mechanism for regional placement. However, the evidence pack lacks concrete detail on region-selection workflows, and extensive community reports of outages, unreliable networking, and support issues (fly-io-comm-1–19) raise significant caveats about dependable multi-region operation.
